blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language–action (VLA) policies transfer visual and language representations to robot control ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) . World–action models (WAMs) additionally learn visual dynamics alongside actions, drawing on video-based priors for physical interaction ( Li et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . In models that decode actions from predicted visual states, the generated future serves as a plan condition: it helps determine the robot’s next action. Maintaining this condition after execution is therefore part of the control problem.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策将视觉和语言表现转移到机器人控制(Kim等人,2024年;物理智能等人,2025年). 世界行动模型(WAMS)进一步学习视觉动态与行动,利用视频前科进行物理互动(Li等人,2026a); Ye et al., 2026 (英语). 在从预测的视觉状态解码动作的模型中,生成的未来是一个计划条件:它有助于确定机器人的下一个动作. 因此,在执行后维持这一状况是控制问题的一部分。

blocks.en: Execution introduces observations that can disagree with this predicted future. A contact may occur later than expected even when the planned approach and subsequent manipulation remain useful. Reusing the prediction unchanged can preserve the timing error, whereas generating a new future from noise repeats the visual-generation process. The remaining prediction offers a starting point for feedback-driven updating, provided its continuation can be reconciled with the new observation.
blocks.zh: 执行会提出一些与这个预测的未来不相符的意见。 即使计划的办法和随后的操纵仍然有用,接触也可能比预期的晚。 用不变的预测可以保留计时错误,而从噪音中产生新的未来则重复视觉生成过程. 其余的预测为以反馈为动力的更新提供了一个起点,只要其持续进行能与新的观察相一致。

blocks.en: Recent work addresses complementary aspects of this problem. Persistent memory retains earlier observations ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , while efficient WAMs reduce the cost of obtaining representations for action generation ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Feedback-aware execution adjusts how long a plan is followed ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or adapts reused planner context to current observations ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Diffusion planners further show how existing trajectories can be repaired or continued across observations ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Høeg et al., 2024 ) . These developments motivate a central question: how can a WAM revise an already generated visual future under execution feedback and use it to guide the next action?
blocks.zh: 最近的工作涉及这一问题的补充方面。 持续的内存保留了早期的观测结果(Yang等人,2026年),而高效的WAM则降低了为行动生成获取陈述的成本(Yuan等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a). 。 。 。 反馈感知执行调整计划执行时间(Wang等人,2026年)或根据当前观测结果调整复用规划人员的背景(Cai等人,2026年). 传播规划者进一步说明现有轨迹如何可以修复或继续跨越观测(周等人,2023年;Høeg等人,2024年). 这些事态发展引发了一个中心问题:一个WAM如何能够根据执行反馈修订已经产生的视觉未来,并利用它来指导下一步行动?

blocks.en: Our key insight is to maintain the visual future as a persistent action condition that evolves with execution feedback. Saved intermediate denoising states provide starting points within the generation process that produced the plan. These states were formed under earlier observations; continuing them under current feedback requires adapting the remaining generation. We learn this transition with visual and action supervision so that the revised future can guide the next action.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键洞察力是将视觉未来作为持续的行动条件,随着执行反馈而演化. 节省下来的中间点名状态在产生计划的生成过程中提供了起点. 这些状态是根据先前的观测结果形成的;根据目前的反馈继续这些状态需要调整剩余的一代。 我们通过视觉和行动监督来了解这一过渡,以便订正后的未来能够指导下一步行动。

blocks.en: Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP) implements this feedback-driven update through a learned revision bridge. Time-aware history supplies recent detail and older evidence at their original environment timestamps, while a separate record preserves the visual plan and its intermediate generation states. An adaptive policy allocates revision effort by selecting retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from newly sampled noise, using estimated differences from fresh generation. The accepted visual plan and current observations then condition the next action. We instantiate RTP on task-adapted LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) and evaluate it on RoboMME ( Dai et al., 2026 ) and RMBench ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 可视时间规划(RTP)通过学习到的修订桥执行这种反馈驱动的更新. 时间感知历史在他们最初的环境时间戳上提供了最近的细节和较老的证据,而单独的记录则保留了视觉计划及其中间一代状态. 适应性政策通过从新取样的噪音中选择保留、桥梁修订或重新规划来分配修订工作,并使用新生一代的估计差异。 所接受的视觉计划和目前的观测结果将决定下一步的行动。 我们通过任务调整的Lingbot-VA(Li等人,2026a)对RTP进行即时评估,并在RoboMME(Dai等人,2026年)和人民币(Chen等人,2026b)上进行评估。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: ∙ \bullet A persistent visual action condition that is revised across feedback alongside a separate, time-aware record of observed history. ∙ \bullet A learned revision bridge that adapts saved visual-generation states to current feedback through visual and action supervision. ∙ \bullet Closed-loop comparisons separating learned correction, checkpoint source, and action conditioning, together with success–cost comparisons of complete update policies.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 一个持续的视觉动作条件,通过反馈加以修改,同时对观测历史进行单独的、有时间认识的记录。 \Bullet A 学习到的修订桥,通过视觉和动作监督使节省的视觉生成状态适应当前的反馈。 与所学的校正、检查站来源和行动条件进行闭路比较,同时对完整的更新政策进行成功成本比较。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 World–Action Models and Future Conditioning
blocks.zh: 2.1 世界行动模式和未来状况

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers and flow matching support scalable visual and action generation ( Peebles and Xie, 2022 ; Lipman et al., 2022 ) . Joint models couple future observations with robot actions ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2025 ) , with native causal pretraining extending this interface ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Predicted action conditions include latent subgoals and addressable object states ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026c ) ; visual action representations include multiview action images and optical flow ( Zhen et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) . RGB-D prediction ( Guo et al., 2026a ) and action-conditioned self-motion supervision ( Pan et al., 2026 ) further structure the visual future.
blocks.zh: 分散式变压器和流量匹配支持可伸缩视觉和动作生成(Peebles and Xie, 2022 ; Lipman等人, 2022 ). 联合模型将未来的观测与机器人行动结合起来(Zhu等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2025 ),本土因果预训扩展了这一接口(Zhang et al., 2026b ). 预测的行动条件包括潜在的次级目标和可处理对象状态(Chen等人,2026a); Liu et al., 2026c);视觉动作表现包括多视动作影像和光学流(Zhen et al., 2026;Chen et al., 2026c). RGB-D预测(Guo et al., 2026a)和动作有条件的自动机监督(Pan et al., 2026)进一步构建视觉未来.

blocks.en: Efficient models reduce rollout, action-decoding, and future-conditioning costs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Asynchronous systems align predicted context with action execution ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . These methods improve generation or execution efficiency; RTP addresses how the visual condition itself changes after feedback, continuing saved solver states and decoding actions from the accepted clean prefix.
blocks.zh: 高效的模型减少推出,动作解码,以及未来调节成本(袁等人,2026年;李等人,2026年c;马等人,2026年;赵等人,2026年;张等人,2026年a). 同步系统使预测的背景与动作执行相一致(Cai等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年). 这些方法提高了生成或执行的效率;RTP解决了视觉条件本身在反馈后如何变化,继续保存解析器状态,以及从公认的干净前缀解码动作.

blocks.en: 2.2 Feedback Verification and Generative-Plan Revision
blocks.zh: 2.2 核实和基因计划修订

blocks.en: Diffusion policies generate action sequences with receding-horizon execution ( Chi et al., 2023 ) . Revising a generated sample can start from a re-noised endpoint ( Meng et al., 2021 ) ; token-wise noise levels and selective re-noising support incremental and cross-horizon generation ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Adaptive Online Replanning uses plan likelihood to choose retention, repair through re-noising, or resampling ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , while Streaming Diffusion Policy recursively updates a partially denoised action buffer under new observations ( Høeg et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 传播政策产生行动序列,执行退步-视距(Chi等人,2023年)。 修改生成的样本可以从重新点名的终点开始(Meng等人,2021年);象征性的噪声水平和选择性的重新点名支持增量和跨视野生成(Chen等人,2024年;Kim等人,2026年)。 适应性在线再规划使用计划可能性来选择保留,通过重新点名进行修复,或重新加成(周等人,2023年),而流化分散政策则在新观测下递归更新了部分去诺的行动缓冲(Høeg等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Prediction–observation consistency supports adaptive execution and online world-model correction ( Wang et al., 2026 ; An et al., 2026 ) . Action-conditioned rollout search refines proposed plans ( Zhang and Du, 2026 ) . RTP resumes intermediate states saved while generating the existing visual plan, learns their continuation under new observations, and uses the revised visual prefix to condition the next action.
blocks.zh: 预测-观测一致性支持适应性执行和在线世界模型校正(Wang等人,2026年;An等人,2026年). 以行动为条件的推出搜索完善了拟议的计划(张和杜,2026年). RTP恢复了在生成现有视觉计划的同时保存的中间状态,在新的观测下学习它们的续作,并使用修改后的视觉前缀来附加下一个动作的条件.

blocks.en: 2.3 Long-Horizon World Memory
blocks.zh: 2.3 长视世界记忆

blocks.en: Long-horizon video understanding and generation require memory of evolving scenes. Streaming counting and spatial/online understanding probe state maintenance across observations ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Niu et al., 2025 ) , while long-video evidence retrieval connects answers to earlier events ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . Video world models preserve history through consolidation, addressable caches, and retrieval ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 长视视频的理解和生成需要不断演变的场景的记忆. 流线计数和空间/在线理解探测器在跨观测过程中的状态维护(Liu等人,2026b;Li等人,2026b;Niu等人,2025),而长视频证据检索则将先前事件的答案连接起来(Liu等人,2026a). 视频世界模型通过合并,可地址缓存,以及检索来保存历史(Lu等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年;Yi等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Robotic memory combines perceptual features and semantic summaries ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Torne et al., 2026 ) , retrieves relevant experience ( Sridhar et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026b ) , preserves spatial context ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , and tracks progress in cyclic tasks ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . Persistent world–action memory supports action generation from long histories ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . RTP maintains both observed history and a predicted future: multiscale, environment-time-addressed records supply evidence, while a separate predictive record is revised after feedback to condition control.
blocks.zh: 机器人记忆结合了知觉特征和语义摘要(Shi等人,2025年;Torne等人,2026年),检索相关经验(Sridhar等人,2025年;Guo等人,2026年b),保存空间背景(Fang等人,2025年),跟踪循环任务的进展(Wei等人,2025年). 持续的世界-行动记忆支持从漫长的历史中产生行动(Yang等人,2026年)。 RTP既保持观测历史,又保持预测未来:多尺度、环境时空的记录提供证据,而单独的预测记录则在反馈后修订为条件控制。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: RTP maintains observed history and an unexecuted visual plan. At each feedback boundary, it updates the history, selects a plan update, and decodes a new action under current observations (Figure 2 ). Training first adapts LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) to time-aware history (Stage A), then learns feedback-conditioned revision with the adapted model frozen (Stage B), and finally fits a discrepancy estimator with the preceding modules fixed (Stage C).
blocks.zh: RTP保持了被观察的历史和未执行的视觉计划. 在每一个反馈边界上,它都会更新历史,选择计划更新,并解码在当前观测下的新动作(图2 ). 训练首先将LingBot-VA(Li et al., 2026a )适应时间认识历史(Stage A),然后用经过调整的模型冷冻(Stage B)学习回馈条件修订,最后与之前固定的模块(Stage C)匹配了差异估计器.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : The RTP feedback loop. The upper row illustrates a fresh plan root. At each feedback boundary, update factual history, compare prediction with feedback, and run one selected visual update. Save the accepted record and decode a new action from its next prefix and current facts.
blocks.zh: 图2:RTP反馈循环. 上行显示一个新的计划根. 在每个反馈边界上,更新事实历史,将预测与反馈进行比较,并运行一个选定的视觉更新. 从下一个前缀和当前事实中保存被接受的记录并解码新动作.

blocks.en: RTP achieves the highest observed task-averaged success among the compared methods on both RoboMME and RMBench (Tables 1 and 2 ). With the same time-aware model, updating persistent visual plans improves success over fresh replanning by 8.2 and 4.9 percentage points, respectively, based on the displayed rates. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: RTP maintains a visual future as a persistent action condition, revising saved generation states under execution feedback. The learned-residual comparison provides the clearest component evidence; checkpoint-source and prefix effects are less precisely resolved. Removing action supervision improves visual error while lowering success (Table 18 ), separating prediction accuracy from control utility. Recurrent fitting improves discrepancy control without establishing a task-success gain over the matched refit. Evaluation uses LingBot-VA, finite prediction windows, synchronous execution, and controlled delays. Extending this mechanism across longer interactions offers a direction for persistent, revisable, feedback-driven WAM memory.
blocks.zh: RTP维持一个视觉未来作为持续的行动条件,在执行反馈中修订保存的生成状态. 学习-剩余比较提供了最清楚的组成部分证据;检查站-来源和前缀效应没有那么精确。 移除动作监督可以改善视觉错误,同时降低成功率(表18),将预测精度与控制效用区分开来. 经常性安装改进了差异控制,但没有确定任务成功收益高于相应翻新。 评价使用LingBot-VA,有限预测窗口,同步执行,以及可控延迟. 将这一机制延伸至较长的相互作用,为持续、可修改、反馈驱动的WAM内存提供了方向。

blocks.en: Base adaptation uses only benchmark training demonstrations, with RMBench’s 50 demonstrations/task and RoboMME’s supplied training manifest. AdamW uses learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , coefficients ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , weight decay 0.1, effective batch 8, ten linear warmup updates, and a constant rate thereafter. The final checkpoint follows 10,000 RoboMME or 50,000 RMBench updates. The foundation signature contains dataset digests, training seed, sampling configuration, preprocessing, and model checkpoint digest.
blocks.zh: 基础适应只使用基准训练示范,人民币50个示范/任务和RoboMME提供训练清单。 AdamW使用学习速率10 - 5 10^{-5},系数(0.9,0.95)(0.9,0.95),重量衰减0.1,有效批次8,10线性热速率更新,之后保持恒定速率. 最终检查站跟随10,000架RoboMME或50,000人民币更新. 基础签名包含数据集摘要,培训种子,采样配置,预处理,以及示范检查站摘要.

blocks.en: With the foundation frozen, trajectory collection uses the fresh controller on disjoint reset keys and retains success and failure episodes. Collection trajectories have zero-based indices within each task: indices congruent to 4 modulo 5 form calibration, all others fitting. Collection starts with 100 trajectories/task and extends in blocks of 20 until each split contains its required valid tuples. A tuple needs an archived fresh parent, complete applied blocks through its selected feedback endpoint, a complete following action block, and a nonempty subsequent observation intersection. Recording ends at terminal flags. Tuples are uniquely keyed by trajectory, parent root, and feedback boundary; trajectory-level splitting prevents overlap between fitting and calibration.
blocks.zh: 随着基础被冻结,轨迹收藏在脱节重置密钥时使用新的控制器,并保留成功和失败的发生. 收集轨迹在每项任务中都有零基指数: 指数与 4 modulo 5 形式校准一致,所有其他适合. 收藏从100个轨迹/任务开始,以20个区块延伸,直到每个区块都包含其所需的有效拖曳. Tuple需要一个存档的新父,完整的应用块通过其选定的反馈端点,一个完整的之后的动作块,以及一个非空的随后的观测交叉点. 记录结束于终端旗帜。 Tuples由轨迹,母根和反馈边界进行独特的密钥;轨迹级的分割可以防止安装和校准之间的重叠.

blocks.en: Fitting-set sampling selects 800 tuples/task without replacement using seed 1: 12,800 on RoboMME and 7,200 on RMBench. Calibration sampling uses seed 0: 256/task on RoboMME (4,096 total), and 456 for RMBench R01 plus 455 for each remaining task (4,096 total). Sampling follows a fixed collection manifest. All tuples from a trajectory stay in one split. An additional, separate cost-matching pool contains 20 trajectories/task for cost-matching calibration. Diagnostic and test resets occur in none of these pools.
blocks.zh: Fitting-set采样采用1号种子选择800个拖轮/任务,不更换:在RoboMME上选择12 800个,在人民币上选择7 200个。 校准采样使用0号种子:256/任务在RoboMME上(共4,096枚),456枚人民币R01加455枚余下任务(共4,096枚). 取样遵循固定的收集清单。 所有来自轨道的拖累 停留在一个分裂。 另外一个单独的成本匹配池包含20个用于成本匹配校准的轨迹/任务. 诊断和测试复试没有发生在这些池。

Calibration quotas are ( 86 , 85 , 85 ) (86,85,85) for RoboMME, ( 152,152,152 ) (152,152,152) for RMBench R01, and ( 152,152,151 ) (152,152,151) for its other tasks. Collection continues until every quota is filled; parent identity and original checkpoint metadata remain fixed. The fresh behavior continuation from the selected physical state supplies observed future groups and the next action target. The action target is the decoder’s continuous denormalized command before actuator clipping/discrete gripper conversion; factual records contain the separately recorded applied commands.

blocks.en: Default fresh-parent bridge fitting jointly optimizes the residual and DiffEncode through both depths. An independent fresh reference root remains fixed per tuple and epoch; revised and reference calls within that tuple share an action seed. Bridge and estimator fitting both use AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , coefficients ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , effective batch 16, ten epochs, gradient-norm clipping at 1, and the final epoch. Frozen base parameters have gradients disabled, but their operations remain differentiable with respect to the residual-dependent inputs.

blocks.en: Per tuple, two-depth bridge fitting executes 15 differentiable visual intervals and two 50-interval action calls; two-root Fresh-20+C executes 40 visual intervals with the same action work. Reference construction is separate. Expanding retain, both bridges and two fresh references costs at most 55 visual and 250 action intervals. Forward counts include every executed call and count shared features once. The reported training-work counts separate tuple expansion from differentiable fitting; Appendix F reports controller timing, persistent storage, and parameter counts.

blocks.en:
Cost-matched adaptive reconstruction policies use one positive multiplier on both tolerances, fitted only on the separate nominal cost pool. The search covers a fixed 41-point log-multiplier grid from − 2 -2 to 2 2 and minimizes the absolute mean-step difference from primary RTP, breaking ties toward lower cost and then smaller multiplier. The achieved difference characterizes the match. The multiplier remains frozen during test and perturbation evaluation; a matching target does not guarantee matching off-distribution cost.
Binary retain/fresh uses the primary retain heads and unchanged thresholds. It retains the unexecuted plan when valid and both scores pass, and selects fresh otherwise. It changes the candidate family without fitting another success predictor. On any identical pre-decision record, binary and full RTP must agree on whether to retain: both test the same mode-zero score first. Shared reset and initial randomness make this equality mandatory at their first feedback boundary. After their actions diverge, decision-level equivalence applies only at identical states; aggregate retain fractions need not remain equal.

二进制保留/重新使用主保留头和不变阈值。 它保留了有效且两个分数均通过时未执行的计划,另选新鲜. 它改变了候选人的家庭,而没有配上另一个成功的预测器。 在任何相同的决定前记录上,二进制和完整的RTP必须同意是否保留:两者首先测试相同的模式-零分. 共享重置和初始随机性使得这种平等在其第一个反馈边界上成为强制性的. 在它们的行动出现分歧后,决策级的等同性仅适用于相同的状态;总的留存分数不需要保持等同.

blocks.en: C.1 Action Inputs

blocks.en: Every factorial cell updates the visual record with Bridge-10 under current facts. The action call independently uses previous/current factual content and retained/revised active prefix. Structural fresh fallback uses current facts in all cells. The visual record stores the revised plan in every cell, even if the action decoder reads the retained prefix. All cells subsequently follow their own actions and feedback.

Default training covers all three reusable feedback boundaries of archived fresh parents. The age/length ablation jointly removes those lifecycle coordinates and refits the estimator with adjusted layer widths on the same tuples. Recurrent fitting uses a disjoint pool collected under the frozen default policy and its accepted records, including newly created endpoints and missing checkpoints. Valid tuples follow the same per-task feedback-boundary quotas as default training. A fresh behavior continuation cloned from each physical state supplies targets. Bridge fitting averages the loss in Section 3.2 over the depths with available checkpoints in each tuple. The matched parent refit uses a separate archived-parent pool with identical tuple counts, feedback-boundary quotas, epochs, and optimizer settings. Within each task and feedback-boundary stratum, it mirrors the recurrent depth-availability masks for correction fitting, estimator fitting, and calibration. Both corrections are fitted from their original initialization, followed by their estimators. All rows use the primary distance normalization and frozen tolerances; only the estimation-error multiplier is recalibrated on a disjoint, feedback-boundary-matched split. Table 14 reports whole-policy success alongside the discrepancy checks.
The tolerance-exceedance rate divides selected reusable updates whose offline-expanded visual or action distance exceeds its frozen tolerance by all selected reusable updates.

blocks.en: D.1 Common-Reference and Own-Action Probes

blocks.en: The probes use two disjoint source pools, each with 20 eligible keys/task. In the common-reference pool, a fresh source controller runs under nominal, four-sample, or eight-sample hold conditions, generates a parent at boundary 12, and provides the physical state cloned at 16. Histories through 12 are common for the two hold durations, while feedback over [ 12 , 16 ) [12,16) may differ. Within each condition, candidates start from exactly the same clone. A fresh behavior continuation supplies common observed targets; candidates are not executed for this metric.

All predictions, including fresh, are compared on endpoints 16, 20, and 24. Fresh’s endpoint 28 is excluded. The accepted prefixes are re-decoded with current facts at each intervening boundary.

blocks.en: D.2 Eligibility, Annotation and Losses

blocks.en: Source selection sorts a separately reserved reset pool and takes the first 20 nonterminal sources/task reaching the required snapshot before candidate generation. Paired eligibility requires both hold conditions to reach that snapshot. This source eligibility applies only to diagnostics; primary endpoints retain every reset.

blocks.en: A task-success flag can be recorded while the diagnostic continues to its fixed window end if the benchmark permits continued safe state evolution. Invalid-state or safety termination stops that branch immediately. The source remains in the diagnostic pool with unavailable observations masked and attrition counted by branch. blocks.en:
Loss controls refit separate native corrections on identical data and schedules, changing only one coefficient in Equation 7 to zero. Evaluation uses Fixed bridge-10 without a selector, with current facts and the resulting prefix. Terminal success and common-reference visual error are separate endpoints: they test different targets, so their orderings need not agree.
To isolate learned correction from ordinary feedback retargeting, Fixed bridge-10 with zero residual uses the same native-checkpoint construction and uses current facts but sets the added velocity residual identically to zero. It shares source storage, depth, action decoding, and exhaustion rules with learned Fixed bridge-10. The two policies share reset/initial randomness and the checkpoint-storage protocol; later checkpoint tensors and observations may differ because both policies run their own closed-loop trajectories; this contrast is distinct from changing the checkpoint source or removing one training-loss term.

为了将学到的校正从普通反馈重定向中分离出来,零残基的固定桥-10采用相同的本土检查点构造,并使用当前事实,但将增加的速度残基设定为零。 它与学习的固定桥-10共享源存储,深度,动作解码,以及耗尽规则. 这两项政策共享重设/初始随机性以及检查站存储协议;后来的检查站计数器和观察可能有所不同,因为两项政策都有各自的闭路轨道;这种对比不同于改变检查站来源或删除一个培训损失术语。
